label: Exploratory V5 forward-Seam-Pin with Escape Slack and one-use Brace candidate D1
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, reward, UI, or asset authority.
It keeps Candidate C4's ideal-direct-hit range/damage, forward-Stitch, and equal 128-unit non-refilling Escape Slack rules.
Each actor has one public Brace action for the match. Brace consumes the whole turn and reduces only the next opposing direct hit by 50%; it expires if that opposing turn contains no cast.
Brace does not heal, reflect damage, block movement, change turn order, or protect an actor before their first turn. Terrain, aim, splash, animation, and production counter-effects remain excluded.
